state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: On the BookSum book-length summarization dataset, the paper compares against the best extractive (BertExt) and abstractive (T5) models and an extractive oracle. Its 175B models beat all non-oracle baselines on ROUGE by 3-4 points and approach the extractive oracle, and significantly outperform all baselines on BERTScore including the oracle; the 6B models are comparable to baselines on ROUGE and significantly outperform all baselines on BERTScore, including an 11B T5 model fine-tuned on BookSum.
title: BookSum: 175B models beat the best non-oracle baselines by 3-4 ROUGE points
